feature: HM-516 View Posts Tab Default Pagination Android

missing_test_cases.title: Owner view of anonymous post shows author name
missing_test_cases.reason: Requirement REQ-008 states that anonymity is stripped only for non‑owner viewers; the owner must still see their own name.

missing_test_cases.title: Visibility enum handling when post_mentions records are missing for MENTIONED visibility
missing_test_cases.reason: The backend should reject a MENTIONED post without corresponding post_mentions; UI must display an error placeholder.

missing_test_cases.title: Attempt to load next page after reaching end does not trigger additional network calls
missing_test_cases.reason: Ensures pagination stop condition is enforced at the client side, preventing unnecessary API traffic.

prd_clarifications: Is the default page size fixed at 10 or configurable per device?
When an anonymous post is viewed by its owner, should the UI display the actual author name or a generic "You" label?
For FOLLOWERS_ONLY visibility, are posts from private accounts treated differently, or is follower relationship the sole criterion?
case_review.recommendation: The test suite covers the majority of the functional requirements for the Posts tab, especially pagination and visibility features. However, critical gaps exist around security‑related anonymity checks and proper isolation of user contexts for visibility filters. Address the critical findings, add the missing owner‑view anonymous test, and clarify the open PRD questions before the next release to ensure robust validation of the new visibility enum and anonymity logic.

traceability_matrix.requirement_summary: Posts tab loads first page with default pagination (page size 10)
Infinite scroll loads next page when user reaches bottom
Empty state UI is shown when no posts exist
Media placeholder is displayed while images load and removed after load
"Read more" expands truncated text and toggles to "Read less"
Scroll position and UI state (e.g., expanded posts) are preserved when navigating away and back
Tab navigation between Posts, Explore, Profile works without data loss
Anonymous posts hide author identity for non‑owner viewers
FOLLOWERS_ONLY visibility filters posts to followers only
MENTIONED visibility shows post only to mentioned users

test_cases.name: Open Posts tab and verify first page loads with posts
test_cases.precondition: User is logged in and has at least 5 posts in the feed

steps.action: Given the user is on the Home screen
When the user taps the Posts tab
Then the first page of posts is displayed
And the list contains at least 5 items

test_cases.expected_result: First page posts are visible and count >= 5

test_cases.name: Scroll to bottom of Posts list and load next page
test_cases.precondition: User is on Posts tab with at least 2 pages of posts

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the user scrolls to the bottom of the list
Then the next page of posts is appended to the list
And the total item count increases by page size

test_cases.name: Verify empty state is shown when no posts exist
test_cases.precondition: User has no posts in the feed

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the feed is empty
Then an empty state message "No posts yet" is displayed
And no list items are visible

test_cases.name: Media placeholder displays while image is loading
test_cases.precondition: User has a post with an image that takes >1s to load

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the post image starts loading
Then a gray placeholder is shown until the image fully loads
And the placeholder disappears once the image is rendered

test_cases.name: Read more expands truncated post text when tapped
test_cases.precondition: User has a post with text > 200 characters

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the user taps the "Read more" link on a truncated post
Then the full post text is displayed
And the link changes to "Read less"

test_cases.expected_result: Full text is shown and link toggles

test_cases.name: Scroll position preserved after navigating away and back to Posts tab
test_cases.precondition: User has scrolled to item 15 on the Posts tab

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab and scrolled to item 15
When the user switches to the Profile tab
And then returns to the Posts tab
Then the list scrolls back to item 15
And the previously expanded "Read more" state is retained

test_cases.expected_result: Scroll and UI state persist across tab switches

test_cases.name: Tab navigation switches correctly between Posts and other tabs
test_cases.precondition: User is on the Home screen with Posts, Explore, and Profile tabs

steps.action: Given the user is on the Home screen
When the user taps the Explore tab
Then the Explore screen is displayed
When the user taps the Posts tab
Then the Posts screen is displayed again

test_cases.name: Pagination stops when no more posts are available
test_cases.precondition: User has exactly 12 posts and page size is 10

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the user scrolls to the bottom of the list
Then a loading indicator appears
And after loading, no new items are added
And a "No more posts" message is shown

test_cases.name: Verify posts with zero-length text do not crash UI
test_cases.precondition: User has a post with empty string as content

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the post with empty text is rendered
Then the post container is displayed without error
And no placeholder text is shown

test_cases.name: Rapidly tapping Read more does not duplicate content
test_cases.precondition: User has a long post with Read more link

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the user taps the Read more link 5 times quickly
Then the post expands only once
And no duplicate text or UI glitches appear

test_cases.name: Post with image exceeding max size shows error placeholder
test_cases.precondition: User has a post with an image > 5MB

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the oversized image starts loading
Then an error placeholder with retry icon is displayed
And tapping retry attempts to reload the image

test_cases.name: Session expiry mid-pagination shows login prompt
test_cases.precondition: User is logged in, session expires after 5 minutes of inactivity

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab and has scrolled to page 2
When the session expires while loading page 3
Then a login prompt overlays the screen
And the user can re-authenticate to continue pagination

test_cases.expected_result: Graceful handling of session expiry during pagination

test_cases.name: Verify RTL text displays correctly in post content
test_cases.precondition: User has a post with Arabic text

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the Arabic post is rendered
Then the text aligns right-to-left
And no layout shift occurs

test_cases.name: Verify screen reader reads post author and content correctly
test_cases.precondition: User has a post with author name and text

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When a screen reader is activated
Then the author name is announced first
And then the post content is read aloud

test_cases.name: Verify posts with special characters do not break pagination logic
test_cases.precondition: User has 15 posts, 5 of which contain emojis and zero-width spaces

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the user scrolls to load all pages
Then all posts are displayed correctly
And pagination continues without errors

test_cases.expected_result: Special characters handled in list rendering

test_cases.name: Verify that tapping back button from Posts tab returns to previous screen
test_cases.precondition: User navigated from Home to Posts tab

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the device back button is pressed
Then the previous screen (Home) is displayed

test_cases.name: Verify posts list does not duplicate items after orientation change
test_cases.precondition: User is on Posts tab with 20 items loaded

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the device orientation changes from portrait to landscape
Then the list retains the same items without duplication
And scroll position is preserved

test_cases.name: Verify that posts with zero likes still display like icon correctly
test_cases.precondition: User has a post with 0 likes

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the post is rendered
Then the like icon is shown in inactive state
And the like count displays "0"

test_cases.name: Verify that tapping a post with anonymous visibility shows no author name
test_cases.precondition: User has a post with visibility EVERYONE but is marked is_anonymous=true

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the anonymous post is rendered
Then the author name is hidden or replaced with "Anonymous"
And the rest of the post content is visible

test_cases.name: Verify that posts with FOLLOWERS_ONLY visibility are hidden from non-followers
test_cases.precondition: User A follows User B; User B posts with FOLLOWERS_ONLY visibility

steps.action: Given User A is logged in and on the Posts tab
When User B's post is rendered
Then the post is visible because User A follows User B
When User C (not following User B) logs in
Then User C does not see User B's FOLLOWERS_ONLY post

test_cases.name: Verify that posts with MENTIONED visibility show only to mentioned users
test_cases.precondition: User D is mentioned in a post by User E with MENTIONED visibility

steps.action: Given User D is logged in and on the Posts tab
When the mentioned post is rendered
Then User D sees the post
When User F (not mentioned) logs in
Then User F does not see the post

test_cases.name: Regression: Verify that existing Posts tab still loads when visibility enum added
test_cases.precondition: User has posts with various visibility settings

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the tab loads
Then all posts that the user is allowed to see are displayed
And no crash occurs due to new visibility field

test_cases.expected_result: Existing functionality intact after enum change

test_cases.name: Regression: Verify that anonymous posts still show correct like counts
test_cases.precondition: User has an anonymous post with 10 likes

steps.action: Given the user is on the Posts tab
When the anonymous post is rendered
Then the like count displays "10"
And the author name is hidden
